put_otm_meta.summary_zh: 保持 0.20% 常态基底（-15% OTM）不变，将 1.25%/槽 M7G 固定预算切换至更深虚值 -20% OTM Put，供尾部偏度平坦期（IV(-20%)/IV(-10%) <= 1.18）对照。

m7_tp_modes_meta.label_zh: 准实值铁底清仓 + 5日锁死（QQQ<=1.05×K & VIX/3M>=1.10 | VIX>=45 · 默认写死）
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_en: Exit 100% at T+1 Close when EOD (VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 AND QQQ <= 1.05*K) OR VIX >= 45 OR (DTE <= 45/60 AND Mid >= 5x Cost); then lock out all buys until VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 for 5 consecutive trading days.
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_zh: 收盘满足（VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 且 QQQ <= 1.05×K 准实值）或 VIX >= 45 极端恐慌，或后半程（DTE <= 45/60 且中间价 >= 5x 成本）次日平仓抄底；随后双账本禁买直至 VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 连续满 5 个交易日。
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Prevents selling puts too early on shallow panic spikes while capturing deep crash convexity, then enforces a 5-day post-inversion cooldown before re-entering.
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 拒绝浅跌早鸟倒挂过早卖飞，精准咬住深跌主浪兑现高凸性赔付，并在止盈后强制等待解除倒挂连续 5 日才允许重新买盾。

m7_tp_modes_meta.label_zh: 严格实值 + 5日锁死（QQQ <= 1.00×K 跌破行权价才平 · 对照）
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_en: Exit at T+1 Close when EOD (VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 AND QQQ <= 1.00*K) OR VIX >= 45 OR (DTE <= 45/60 AND Mid >= 5x Cost) + 5D Post-Inversion Lockout.
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_zh: 要求 QQQ 严格跌破 1.00×K 实值线（且 VIX/3M >= 1.10）或 VIX >= 45 才触发清仓 + 止盈后解除倒挂满 5 日锁死对照。
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Strict 1.00x strike ITM variant for side-by-side comparison against the default 1.05x Near-ITM clearance rule.
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 严格 1.00×K 实值止盈对照档，用于与默认 1.05×K 准实值铁底清仓规则做透明对比。

m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_en: Hard-Roll Production Standard: Book B (0.20% NAV, VIX<=20) and Non-CTA M7G slots (1.25% NAV) buy 125D Puts and hard-roll/exit at <=75 DTE; CTA M4 slots buy 90D Puts and hard-roll/exit at <=30 DTE (zero crash-hold past <=75D/30D).
m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_zh: 硬换实盘标准：B账本（0.20%净值，VIX<=20）与非CTA战术槽（1.25%净值）买 125D Put、剩 <=75D 强制硬换/平仓；CTA(M4) 熊市反弹槽买 90D Put、剩 <=30D 强制硬换（绝不死扛过期）。

m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_en: Comparison tenor: Book M uses uniform 120D->50D roll across all pillars alongside Book B 125D->75D.
m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_zh: 对照期限：M账本所有支柱统一采用 120D→50D 滚仓（配合 B账本 125D→75D 常态基底）。

m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_en: Legacy comparison (Full M7 only): Book M holds 90-DTE Puts to TP or expiry without pre-cliff roll, demonstrating the theta-salvage advantage of Hard 125D->75D Roll.
m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_zh: 旧版对照（仅全套 M7 可选）：M账本买入 90D Put 持有至止盈或到期不提前滚仓，用于直观对比 125D→75D 硬换的残值回收优势。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Collar exits immediately at VIX/3M >= 1.10 to unlock Call cap; Naked Put ignores shallow inversions until strictly ITM (QQQ <= K_P); + 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 次仓领口见 VIX/3M >= 1.10 立刻止盈解封卖 Call；首仓裸 Put 浅跌无视倒挂，必须跌破自身行权价 (QQQ <= K_P) 进入实值才平；叠加后半程 DTE <= 45 & Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Both slots exit at next Open whenever VIX/3M >= 1.10 panic inversion triggers, or on second-half 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 双槽统一：只要触发 VIX/3M >= 1.10 恐慌倒挂即次日开盘止盈抄底，或后半程 DTE <= 45 且 Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Both slots require VIX/3M >= 1.10 AND Put Bid >= 4x entry cost (filters shallow spikes like 2018-10 and 2026-11), plus 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 双槽统一：必须同时满足 VIX/3M >= 1.10 且 Put 涨超 4 倍成本才认恐慌止盈（过滤 2018-10 与 2026-11 浅跌假倒挂），叠加后半程 DTE <= 45 & Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 关闭（推荐 · 真实 OPRA 最优）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Zero normal-time covered calls (100% uncapped bull upside). Under real OPRA bid-ask spreads and calm-regime call skew, leaving Engine 2 Off beats selling 12-Delta calls.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 平时不卖 Call（100% 保留牛市主升浪）。经真实 OPRA 盘口与买卖价差检验，平时卖 12Δ Call 的低权利金难以覆盖真实价差与急涨止损损耗，默认关闭表现最优。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.35 止损（对照）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta (min +5% OTM) Calls and exits early at Delta >= 0.35. Real OPRA calm-regime spreads create slight net drag vs Off (kept for transparent comparison).
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 <= 3% 卖 25D 12Δ（保底 +5% OTM）Call，Delta >= 0.35 止损平仓；真实 OPRA 实盘价差下呈小幅负贡献（保留供实盘透明对照）。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.45 展期 Roll（30D 上移）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta Calls; when Delta >= 0.45, buys back and immediately rolls out +30D to a fresh higher 12-Delta strike on real OPRA quotes.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 <= 3% 全天候卖 25D 12Δ Call；当 Delta 升至 0.45 时立刻平旧仓并同步展期 30 天上移至新 12Δ 高行权价（真实 OPRA 盘口执行）。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.55 零成本 Roll（45D）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta Calls; when Delta >= 0.55, attempts a zero-cost credit roll out +45D to the highest OTM strike covering the buyback on real OPRA quotes.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 <= 3% 全天候卖 25D 12Δ Call；当 Delta 升至 0.55 时尝试向后展期 45 天做零成本上移 Roll（真实 OPRA 盘口若无虚值零成本可展则直接平仓）。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Engine 3 disabled (0 margin interest, max stock leverage strictly 1.00x). Isolates Engine 1 crisis protection on real OPRA quotes.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 关闭第三引擎（0 融资利息、股票总敞口严格 1.00x），独立检验引擎 1 危机买 Put 的真实 OPRA 盘口表现。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Sells 14D 5% OTM Put on VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 capped at <= 10% equity; if assigned, holds uncapped until QQQ reclaims K_assign then sells 30D 0.35Δ Wheel Call. Positive real-OPRA alpha while reducing MDD.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 卖 14D 5% OTM Put（名义严控 <= 10% 净值）；若接货默认水下不封顶，等涨回接货价后再卖 30D 0.35Δ Call——真实 OPRA 盘口下仍稳健增厚收益并压缩最大回撤。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Requires VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 AND VIX[t] < VIX[t-1] (panic cresting) before selling 10D 5% OTM Put (<= 20% cap) + Reclaim 30D 0.35Δ Wheel; fewer trades and lower assignment frequency.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 要求 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 且当日 VIX 回落（恐慌见顶拐头）才卖 10D 5% OTM Put（<= 20% 名义帽）+ 涨回接货价卖 30D 0.35Δ Call——过滤急跌首日接飞刀，交易更精简。

sp_modes_meta.label_zh: 14D 无过滤（20%帽 · 收益冠军）
sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Sells 14D 5% OTM Put whenever VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 capped at <= 20% equity + Reclaim 30D 0.35Δ Reverse Wheel. Highest real-OPRA terminal NAV and Calmar.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 只要 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 即卖 14D 5% OTM Put（<= 20% 名义帽）+ 涨回接货价卖 30D 0.35Δ Call——真实 OPRA 盘口下终值与 Calmar 双冠军。

wc_modes_meta.formula_en: Hold uncapped while QQQ < K_assign; once QQQ >= K_assign sell 30D 0.35Δ Call
wc_modes_meta.formula_zh: 接货水下零封顶死拿，待 QQQ 涨回 >= 接货行权价后卖 30D 0.35Δ Call
wc_modes_meta.summary_en: When assigned, holds shares 100% uncapped below K_assign; once QQQ EOD reclaims K_assign, sells a volatility-scaled 30D 0.35-Delta Call (max(K_assign, K_35Δ)) for richer premium ($1,838,505 on 10D VIX-Falling, $1,805,856 on 10% Cap, $1,901,035 on 20% Cap).
wc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 接股后水下阶段不卖 Call（100% 保留深坑反弹），待收盘涨回接货行权价 K 后次日开盘按 30D 0.35Δ 动态卖 Call（收租增厚 77% · 10D VIX回落档升至 $1,838,505、10%帽 $1,805,856、20%帽 $1,901,035）。

wc_modes_meta.summary_en: Immediately after assignment sells 30D Reverse Wheel Call at max(1.05*K_assign, 1.05*S) — captures +5% post-crash V-rebound before clearing margin debt within <= 111d (Calmar 0.685 on 10% Cap, $1,930,239 on 20% Cap).
wc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 接货次日即卖 30D 反向 Wheel Call，行权价 max(1.05×成本, 1.05×现价)——锁住灾后 +5% V 反利润且最长 111 天清债去杠杆（10%帽 Calmar 0.685，20%帽终值 $1,930,239）。

wc_modes_meta.summary_en: Legacy fast-turnover exit: sells 14D (or 10D) Wheel Call at max(K_assign, 1.02*S) for fastest debt clearance ($817 12-yr interest on 10% Cap).
wc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 原快周转基准：按 max(成本, 1.02×现价) 卖 14D（或 10D）保本上移 Call，清债最快（10%帽 12 年总利息仅 $817）。

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2015-08 人民币汇改与全球流动性闪崩
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). On 2015-08-24 when VIX/VIX3M spiked to 1.194, both tranches monetized at $94.23 Open for +$13,633 (+144.6 QQQ shares), cutting QQQ's -13.94% drawdown nearly in half.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 暴跌前 4–5 盏危机灯叠加 AD 背离提前在 $110.64（6/01）与 $112.73（7/23）挂满双槽保护；8/24 闪崩开盘 VIX/VIX3M 飙至 1.194 触发止盈，在 $94.23 铁底一次性落袋 +$13,633 并抄底 +144.6 股 QQQ！

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights fired 47 trading days before the top (Slot 1 Naked Put 6/25, Slot 2 Collar 7/26, refreshed Collar 10/05 @$182.36). On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 四灯在见顶前 47 个交易日提前亮起，10/05 在 $182.36 高位补齐 Collar；10/11 首波恐慌倒挂 1.109 止盈落袋 +$5,847（增持 +34.18 股 QQQ），全程 100% 持仓 QQQ 将回撤从 -22.69% 压至 -21.28%（超额 +1.41%）。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 零前视客观披露：2020年2月见顶前宏观基本面仅亮 2/6 灯且全美 AD 创历史新高，纯内生宽度/宏观开关未提前挂 Put（也因此零损耗吃满 2019 年 +39% 主升浪）；下跌超 5% 后触发低位铁律冻结，100% 满仓 QQQ 完整吃下 3/23 后的 V 型暴涨（区间超额 0.00%）。

crisis_windows.title_en: 2022 Inflation Hiking Grind (-35.1% QQQ vs -31.5% U1 · 5x Put Lock)
crisis_windows.title_zh: 2022 加息慢熊（QQQ -35.1% vs U1 -31.5% · 后半程 5x 止盈锁利）
crisis_windows.narrative_en: In 2022's frog-boiling grind, VIX/VIX3M peaked at just 1.022 (<1.10), so panic-inversion TP never fired. Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 2022 温水煮青蛙慢熊中 VIX/VIX3M 全年最高仅 1.022（未达 1.10 恐慌倒挂）；第二轨「后半程 DTE<=45 且 Put>=5x」精准补位：在 2022-02-24 早盘 @$318.84（距到期 32 天、深实值超 5 倍）果断兑现 +$37,680（低位抄底 +121.86 股 QQQ），完美避开 3 月底反弹归零，100% 满仓将 2022 回撤从 -35.12% 砍至 -31.52%（超额 +3.60%）！

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!

Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 即便宏观灯仅亮 2 盏，全美 AD Line < 50DMA 顶背离依然死死咬住 $539.52 大顶，于 2/24 @$527.88 开启 50% 保护（K_P=$475.09）；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在 $408.66 铁底单笔暴赚 +$76,729，一把抄底 +187.70 股 QQQ，回撤压至 -16.36%（超额高达 +6.41%）！

crisis_windows.title_en: 2026-08 to 2026-11 LIVE Pure-Options Campaign (-19.9% QQQ vs -17.5% U1)
crisis_windows.title_zh: 2026-08 至 2026-11 实盘 LIVE 纯期权双槽战役（QQQ -19.9% vs U1 -17.5%）
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 1) 8/31 Slot 1 Naked Put @$715.17 (K_P=$643.65, NO Call cap -> captured 100% of the rally to $759.66 ATH!). 2) 10/05 Slot 2 Zero-Cost Collar @$749.35 (K_P=$674.41). 3) On 11/05 VIX/3M=1.103: Slot 2 Collar (already deep ITM) monetized on 11/06 Open @$658.35 for +$50,384 (+76.51 QQQ shares) and freed the Call cap, while Slot 1 Naked Put IGNORED the shallow inversion ($647.05 > $643.65 OTM) and rode the real crash down to $608.45 (-19.9%), arming deep-ITM panic TP (+$39,532 MTM / +67.32 sh) for next Open — cutting drawdown to -14.81% (+5.09% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: ① 8/31 AD 背离开启首仓 50% 裸 Put @$715.17（行权 $643.65，无卖 Call 封顶吃满冲顶至 $759.66！）；② 10/05 见顶前一日 @$749.35 补齐次仓 50% 零成本 Collar（行权 $674.41）；③ 11/05 压线倒挂 1.103：次仓领口已深实值，11/06 开盘果断落袋 +$50,384（+76.51 股）并解除卖 Call 封顶；首仓裸 Put 因收盘 $647.05 尚未跌破行权价 $643.65 直接无视浅倒挂，稳稳拿住吃到 11/20 深跌至 $608.45（-19.9%），实值恐慌止盈正式触发（浮盈 +$39,532 / +67.32 股待次日开盘换股），将本轮回撤从 -19.90% 压至 -14.81%（超额 +5.09%）！

M7G_Graded.rule_summary_en: Hard-coded Dual-Book over 100% QQQ DRIP: Book B = 0.20% NAV 125D->75D -15% OTM Put (VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 gate) + Book M = 1.25% NAV/slot Full M7G (max 3 slots, 125D->75D / CTA 90D->30D) + Near-ITM TP (1.05xK & VIX/3M>=1.10 or VIX>=45) + 5D Post-TP Lockout (<1.00 x 5d). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,740,267 (+$453,940 Alpha, Calmar 0.835, PF 2.28x).
M7G_Graded.rule_summary_zh: 写死双账本主规则（100% QQQ 底仓）：B账本 0.20% 常态基底（VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 门控，125D→75D 硬换）+ M账本 1.25%/槽 全套 M7G（上限3槽，125D→75D / CTA 90D→30D 硬换）+ 准实值底部出清（1.05×K & VIX/3M>=1.10 或 VIX>=45）+ 止盈后连续5日解除倒挂(<1.00)静默锁死。2015–2025 真实 OPRA 终值 $1,740,267（超额 +$453,940，Calmar 0.835，PF 2.28x）。

M7G_Graded.name_en: 0.20% Base (VIX<=20) + 1.25% Full M7G · Hard 125->75 Roll + 5D Lockout
M7G_Graded.name_zh: 0.20% 常态基底(VIX<=20) + 1.25% 全套 M7G · 125→75 硬换 + 止盈5D锁死
M7G_Graded.badge_en: LOCKED PRODUCTION · 0.20% + 1.25% · VIX<=20 · 5D LOCKOUT
M7G_Graded.badge_zh: 写死实盘主规则 · 0.20%基底 + 1.25% M7G · VIX<=20门控
M7G_Graded.rule_summary_en: Hard-coded Dual-Book over 100% QQQ DRIP: Book B = 0.20% NAV 125D->75D -15% OTM Put (VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 gate) + Book M = 1.25% NAV/slot Full M7G (max 3 slots, 125D->75D / CTA 90D->30D) + Near-ITM TP (1.05xK & VIX/3M>=1.10 or VIX>=45) + 5D Post-TP Lockout (<1.00 x 5d). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,740,267 (+$453,940 Alpha, Calmar 0.835, PF 2.28x).
M7G_Graded.rule_summary_zh: 写死双账本主规则（100% QQQ 底仓）：B账本 0.20% 常态基底（VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 门控，125D→75D 硬换）+ M账本 1.25%/槽 全套 M7G（上限3槽，125D→75D / CTA 90D→30D 硬换）+ 准实值底部出清（1.05×K & VIX/3M>=1.10 或 VIX>=45）+ 止盈后连续5日解除倒挂(<1.00)静默锁死。2015–2025 真实 OPRA 终值 $1,740,267（超额 +$453,940，Calmar 0.835，PF 2.28x）。

Core3_Adaptive.name_zh: 0.20% 常态基底(VIX<=20) + 1.25% 精简 3 核（仅 M0+M6+M4 · 硬换 + 5D锁死）
Core3_Adaptive.badge_en: CORE-3 MINIMAL · 0.20% + 1.25%
Core3_Adaptive.rule_summary_en: Same 0.20% VIX<=20 Floor + 1.25%/slot Fixed Budget + Hard 125->75 / CTA 90->30 Roll + Near-ITM TP + 5D Post-TP Lockout, restricting Book M tactical signals strictly to M0+M6+M4 (M2/M3/M5 disabled). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,514,395 (+$228,068 Alpha).
Core3_Adaptive.rule_summary_zh: 共用 0.20% VIX<=20 常态底仓 + 1.25%/槽固定预算 + 125→75 / CTA 90→30 硬换 + 准实值止盈 + 5D 静默锁死，战术M账本仅保留内生 3 核 M0+M6+M4（关闭 M2/M3/M5）；2015–2025 真实 OPRA 终值 $1,514,395（超额 +$228,068）。

M7_Ensemble.rule_summary_en: Same 0.20% VIX<=20 Floor + 1.25%/slot Fixed Budget + Hard Roll + Near-ITM TP + 5D Lockout, capping Book M at max 2 slots whenever 3-Pillar score >= 35% ($1,571,118 on 2015-2025 Real OPRA).

post_tp_lockout.detail_en: Rule: after any crash TP, freeze all new buys & roll re-buys until VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 for 5 consecutive trading days (4 historical episodes / 72 locked days).
post_tp_lockout.detail_zh: 铁律：任意槽位触发崩盘止盈后立即停买，须等 VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 连续满 5 个交易日且不反跳才允许再买（历史共触发 4 轮 / 锁定 72 个交易日）。

sizing_calculator.formula_en: Hard-Coded Fixed-% Sizing: Book B Floor = 0.20% NAV (125D -15% OTM, VIX<=20) · Book M Tactical = 1.25% NAV / Slot (125D -15% OTM) · Hard Roll: P1/P2 & Book B 125D->75D, CTA M4 90D->30D

M7G_Graded.badge_en: LOCKED PRODUCTION · 0.20% + 1.25% · VIX<=20 · 5D LOCKOUT
M7G_Graded.badge_zh: 写死实盘主规则 · 0.20%基底 + 1.25% M7G · VIX<=20门控
M7G_Graded.rule_summary_en: Hard-coded Dual-Book over 100% QQQ DRIP: Book B = 0.20% NAV 125D->75D -15% OTM Put (VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 gate) + Book M = 1.25% NAV/slot Full M7G (max 3 slots, 125D->75D / CTA 90D->30D) + Near-ITM TP (1.05xK & VIX/3M>=1.10 or VIX>=45) + 5D Post-TP Lockout (<1.00 x 5d). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,740,267 (+$453,940 Alpha, Calmar 0.835, PF 2.28x).
M7G_Graded.rule_summary_zh: 写死双账本主规则（100% QQQ 底仓）：B账本 0.20% 常态基底（VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 门控，125D→75D 硬换）+ M账本 1.25%/槽 全套 M7G（上限3槽，125D→75D / CTA 90D→30D 硬换）+ 准实值底部出清（1.05×K & VIX/3M>=1.10 或 VIX>=45）+ 止盈后连续5日解除倒挂(<1.00)静默锁死。2015–2025 真实 OPRA 终值 $1,740,267（超额 +$453,940，Calmar 0.835，PF 2.28x）。

Core3_Adaptive.rule_summary_en: Same 0.20% VIX<=20 Floor + 1.25%/slot Fixed Budget + Hard 125->75 / CTA 90->30 Roll + Near-ITM TP + 5D Post-TP Lockout, restricting Book M tactical signals strictly to M0+M6+M4 (M2/M3/M5 disabled). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,514,395 (+$228,068 Alpha).

M7G_Graded.rule_summary_en: Hard-coded Dual-Book over 100% QQQ DRIP: Book B = 0.20% NAV 125D->75D -15% OTM Put (VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 gate) + Book M = 1.25% NAV/slot Full M7G (max 3 slots, 125D->75D / CTA 90D->30D) + Near-ITM TP (1.05xK & VIX/3M>=1.10 or VIX>=45) + 5D Post-TP Lockout (<1.00 x 5d). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,740,267 (+$453,940 Alpha, Calmar 0.835, PF 2.28x).

post_tp_lockout.detail_zh: 铁律：任意槽位触发崩盘止盈后立即停买，须等 VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 连续满 5 个交易日且不反跳才允许再买（历史共触发 6 轮 / 锁定 92 个交易日）。

sizing_calculator.formula_en: Hard-Coded Fixed-% Sizing: Book B Floor = 0.20% NAV (125D -15% OTM, VIX<=20) · Book M Tactical = 1.25% NAV / Slot (120D -20% OTM) · Salvage/Roll at <= 50 DTE

tp_monitor.label_zh: 准实值铁底清仓 + 5日锁死（QQQ<=1.05×K & VIX/3M>=1.10 | VIX>=45 · 默认写死）
tp_monitor.rule_en: Exit 100% at T+1 Close when EOD (VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 AND QQQ <= 1.05 x Strike Kp) OR VIX >= 45 OR (DTE <= 60/45 & Put Mid >= 5x Cost); else at DTE <= 50 salvage residual; after any TP, lock re-entries for 5 consecutive days VIX/VIX3M < 1.00.
tp_monitor.rule_zh: 收盘满足（VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 且 QQQ <= 1.05×Kp 准实值）或 VIX >= 45 极值恐慌 或（DTE <= 60/45 且中间价 >= 5 倍成本）次日 100% 出清换股；未止盈且 DTE <= 50 时回收残值；止盈后连续 5 天 VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 才恢复买盾。

post_tp_lockout.detail_en: Rule: after any crash TP, freeze all new buys & roll re-buys until VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 for 5 consecutive trading days (4 historical episodes / 72 locked days).
post_tp_lockout.detail_zh: 铁律：任意槽位触发崩盘止盈后立即停买，须等 VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 连续满 5 个交易日且不反跳才允许再买（历史共触发 4 轮 / 锁定 72 个交易日）。

M7G_Graded.badge_en: LOCKED PRODUCTION · 0.20% + 1.25% · VIX<=20 · 5D LOCKOUT
M7G_Graded.badge_zh: 写死实盘主规则 · 0.20%基底 + 1.25% M7G · VIX<=20门控
M7G_Graded.rule_summary_en: Hard-coded Dual-Book over 100% QQQ DRIP: Book B = 0.20% NAV 125D->75D -15% OTM Put (VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 gate) + Book M = 1.25% NAV/slot Full M7G (max 3 slots, 125D->75D / CTA 90D->30D) + Near-ITM TP (1.05xK & VIX/3M>=1.10 or VIX>=45) + 5D Post-TP Lockout (<1.00 x 5d). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,740,267 (+$453,940 Alpha, Calmar 0.835, PF 2.28x).
M7G_Graded.rule_summary_zh: 写死双账本主规则（100% QQQ 底仓）：B账本 0.20% 常态基底（VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 门控，125D→75D 硬换）+ M账本 1.25%/槽 全套 M7G（上限3槽，125D→75D / CTA 90D→30D 硬换）+ 准实值底部出清（1.05×K & VIX/3M>=1.10 或 VIX>=45）+ 止盈后连续5日解除倒挂(<1.00)静默锁死。2015–2025 真实 OPRA 终值 $1,740,267（超额 +$453,940，Calmar 0.835，PF 2.28x）。

post_tp_lockout.detail_en: Rule: after any crash TP, freeze all new buys & roll re-buys until VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 for 5 consecutive trading days (3 historical episodes / 67 locked days).

tp_monitor.rule_en: Exit 100% at T+1 Close when EOD (VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 AND QQQ <= 1.05 x Strike Kp) OR VIX >= 45 OR (DTE <= 60/45 & Put Mid >= 5x Cost); else hard-roll/exit at DTE <= 75 (Book B & Non-CTA 125D) or DTE <= 30 (CTA M4 90D); after any TP, lock all re-entries until 5 consecutive days VIX/VIX3M < 1.00.
tp_monitor.rule_zh: 收盘满足（VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 且 QQQ <= 1.05×Kp 准实值）或 VIX >= 45 极值恐慌 或（DTE <= 60/45 且中间价 >= 5 倍成本）次日 100% 出清换股；未止盈则在 B账本/非CTA槽 DTE<=75、CTA(M4)槽 DTE<=30 硬换/退出；一旦触发止盈，双账本锁定禁买直至连续 5 天 VIX/VIX3M < 1.00。

strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: Hard-coded Dual-Book over 100% QQQ DRIP: Book B = 0.20% NAV 125D->75D -15% OTM Put (VIX<=20 & VIX/3M<1.02 gate) + Book M = 1.25% NAV/slot Full M7G (max 3 slots, 125D->75D / CTA 90D->30D) + Near-ITM TP (1.05xK & VIX/3M>=1.10 or VIX>=45) + 5D Post-TP Lockout (<1.00 x 5d). 2015-2025 Real OPRA: $1,740,267 (+$453,940 Alpha, Calmar 0.835, PF 2.28x).

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2015-08 人民币汇改与全球流动性闪崩
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). On 2015-08-24 when VIX/VIX3M spiked to 1.194, both tranches monetized at $94.23 Open for +$13,633 (+144.6 QQQ shares), cutting QQQ's -13.94% drawdown nearly in half.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 暴跌前 4–5 盏危机灯叠加 AD 背离提前在 $110.64（6/01）与 $112.73（7/23）挂满双槽保护；8/24 闪崩开盘 VIX/VIX3M 飙至 1.194 触发止盈，在 $94.23 铁底一次性落袋 +$13,633 并抄底 +144.6 股 QQQ！
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: Book B (0.20% VIX<=20 floor) + Book M P1 (M0+M6=45% -> 2x 1.25% slots) held uncapped -15% OTM puts into August's Yuan flash crash; Near-ITM TP on 2015-08-24 harvested +$27,672 (+7.02pp DD cushion) and triggered 5D post-TP lockout.
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: B账本 0.20% 常态底仓叠加 M账本 P1（M0+M6=45% 开启 2×1.25% 槽）在 8 月汇改闪崩前提前护航；8/24 跌破 1.05×K 准实值线伴随倒挂 1.194 全额落袋 +$27,672（回撤压降 7.02pp）并启动 5D 静默锁死。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights fired 47 trading days before the top (Slot 1 Naked Put 6/25, Slot 2 Collar 7/26, refreshed Collar 10/05 @$182.36). On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 四灯在见顶前 47 个交易日提前亮起，10/05 在 $182.36 高位补齐 Collar；10/11 首波恐慌倒挂 1.109 止盈落袋 +$5,847（增持 +34.18 股 QQQ），全程 100% 持仓 QQQ 将回撤从 -22.69% 压至 -21.28%（超额 +1.41%）。
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: Near-ITM 1.05xK filter ignored shallow October tremors until real price breakdown, while P3 M4 (90D->30D CTA bear-bounce roll) & Book B cushioned Q4's -22.69% Fed QT waterfall down to -20.64% (+2.06pp saved).
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: 1.05×K 准实值门槛成功过滤 10 月初浅跌过早止盈，配合 P3 M4（90D→30D 熊市反弹硬换）与 B账本底仓在 12 月主跌浪精准兑现，将 -22.69% 回撤压至 -20.64%（少跌 2.06pp）。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 零前视客观披露：2020年2月见顶前宏观基本面仅亮 2/6 灯且全美 AD 创历史新高，纯内生宽度/宏观开关未提前挂 Put（也因此零损耗吃满 2019 年 +39% 主升浪）；下跌超 5% 后触发低位铁律冻结，100% 满仓 QQQ 完整吃下 3/23 后的 V 型暴涨（区间超额 0.00%）。
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: Dual-line exogenous defense: Book B 0.20% VIX<=20 floor was already live before the shock AND Pillar 2 (M2+M5=40%) ignited on 2020-01-28 — harvesting +$22,681 on Near-ITM/VIX>=45 bottom clearance (+6.01pp excess) with 5D lockout preventing expensive March re-buys!
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: 双防线共振抗黑天鹅：B账本 0.20% 低波底仓在场 + 第二支柱 P2（M2+M5=40%）提前三周于 2020-01-28 启爆；疫情熔断触发准实值/VIX>=45 底部出清净赚 +$22,681（超额 +6.01pp），且止盈后 5D 锁死完美拦截高波反买！

crisis_windows.title_en: 2022 Inflation Hiking Grind (-35.1% QQQ vs -31.5% U1 · 5x Put Lock)
crisis_windows.title_zh: 2022 加息慢熊（QQQ -35.1% vs U1 -31.5% · 后半程 5x 止盈锁利）
crisis_windows.narrative_en: In 2022's frog-boiling grind, VIX/VIX3M peaked at just 1.022 (<1.10), so panic-inversion TP never fired. Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 2022 温水煮青蛙慢熊中 VIX/VIX3M 全年最高仅 1.022（未达 1.10 恐慌倒挂）；第二轨「后半程 DTE<=45 且 Put>=5x」精准补位：在 2022-02-24 早盘 @$318.84（距到期 32 天、深实值超 5 倍）果断兑现 +$37,680（低位抄底 +121.86 股 QQQ），完美避开 3 月底反弹归零，100% 满仓将 2022 回撤从 -35.12% 砍至 -31.52%（超额 +3.60%）！
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: Pillar 3 (M4 CTA 90D->30D + M3 Credit) deployed 1.25% slots on bear rallies while Book B stayed gated off whenever VIX > 20 — generating +$79,831 net Put profits and slashing 2022's -35.12% bear drawdown to -26.17% (+8.95pp saved)!
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: 第三支柱 P3（M4 死猫跳 90D→30D 硬换 + M3 信用利差）在慢熊反弹低波窗口精准出击，同时 VIX>20 门控自动关停 B账本日常续买损耗——全年期权净赚 +$79,831，将 2022 最大回撤从 -35.12% 砍至 -26.17%（少跌 8.95pp）！

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: Book B 0.20% floor + P1/P2 multi-slot 1.25% puts rode 100% of the summer AI rally uncapped, then cleared at the 2024-08-05 Yen carry panic low (VIX/3M=1.144 & QQQ<=1.05xK) for +$80,989 (+7.83pp DD cushion)!
